description: power tower training dataset for deep learning model is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by Fang Fang, Laurens Hagendoorn, Fiona Gallagher, Geert Koster, Anders Pedersen, Clara Ivanescu, Parth Khare, Grayson Clapp (NEO). This is the training dataset for power tower deep learning model development. The dataset contains 50cm resolution Mapbox image tiles (Maxar imagery) as well as the power tower location presence in the imagery as geojson file. Both the geographic coordinates and the pixel coordinates of the power towers have been incorporated. Coverage: India, Liberia, Yemen. It has 4 files in GeoJSON, ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2023 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
